title: Experience Center account management: organization profile, subscriptions, branding, and Zscaler service in Russia

checks.do: Which logo is meant (organization profile, Branding or onboarding) before giving a size limit; the pages differ.

org-profile.statement: The Internet & SaaS service automatically creates a profile for the organization, which can be reviewed and updated on the Organization page (Administration > Administration > Organization).

quotes: The Internet & SaaS service automatically creates a profile for your organization.
On the Organization page (Administration > Administration > Organization), you can review and update company information.

company-id-and-name.statement: The service automatically assigns the organization a Company ID, which might be asked for when requesting Zscaler Support and is not editable; the organization Name is the one provided, is not editable, and appears in the login form the service displays when users authenticate and in user notifications when policy violations occur.

quotes: Company ID: The service automatically assigns your organization a Company ID. You might be asked to provide this ID when requesting Zscaler Support. This field is not editable.
Name: The service displays the organization name that you provided. This field is not editable.
Your organization name appears in the login form that the service displays:

evidence.after: Your organization name appears in the login form
quotes: When users authenticate to the Zscaler service.
In the user notifications, when policy violations occur.

domains-timezone.statement: Domains shows the domains provided when the tenant was provisioned; the time zones listed are those within the geographic location of the primary address, and the primary time zone is used when the organization synchronizes user, group and department information from a directory server.

quotes: Domains: The service displays the domains that you provided when your tenant was provisioned.
The time zones listed are those within the geographic location of your primary address.
The primary time zone is used when your organization synchronizes user, group, and department information from a directory server.

org-logo.statement: The organization profile's Company Logo is uploaded with Upload, and the service supports JPG, GIF and PNG image files of 10 KB size or smaller; the company logo appears in the login form the service displays when users authenticate to the Zscaler service.

quotes: Company Logo: Click Upload to upload a logo. The service supports JPG, GIF, and PNG image files of 10 KB size or smaller.
Your company logo appears in the login form that the service displays:

evidence.after: Your company logo appears in the login form
quotes: When users authenticate to the Zscaler service.

contacts.statement: The primary and secondary Technical Contacts and Billing Contacts are authorized to open Support tickets with the Zscaler service; for Business Contacts the service displays the primary contact information provided, which cannot be edited, and a secondary contact can be entered; contact changes are saved and activated.

quotes: Technical Contacts: The primary and secondary contacts listed here are authorized to open Support tickets with the Zscaler service.
Billing Contacts: The primary and secondary contacts listed here are authorized to open Support tickets with the Zscaler service.

Business Contacts: The service displays the primary contact information that you provided, and you can enter contact information for a secondary contact. You cannot edit the information for the primary contact.
Click Save and activate the change.

subscriptions.statement: Subscriptions define the Internet & SaaS (ZIA) features and levels of functionality available to the organization; the Subscriptions page (Administration > Subscription > Internet & SaaS) lists each subscription with its SKU, Status (Subscribed or Trial, which the table can be filtered by), Usage (the number of users accessing subscription licenses), Licenses, Start Date (when it was enabled) and End Date (when it expires), and the Zscaler Account team is contacted to update subscriptions.

quotes: Subscriptions define the various Internet & SaaS (ZIA) features and levels of functionality that are available to your organization.
On the Subscriptions page (Administration > Subscription > Internet & SaaS)
SKU: The SKU of the subscription.
Status: The status of the subscription (i.e., Subscribed or Trial). You can filter the table results by Status.
Usage: The number of users accessing subscription licenses.
Licenses: The number of licenses for the subscription.
Start Date: The date when the subscription was enabled.
End Date: The date when the subscription expires.
Contact your Zscaler Account team to update your subscriptions.

branding.statement: Branding adds the organization's logo and customizes the email users receive to access the Zscaler Admin Console: the custom logo appears on the login, logout and password reset pages (and in emails), the email Zscaler sends is rebranded and sent from the custom email address, and only admins with Full permissions can customize the logo and email address (Administration > Account Management > Branding).

quotes: Branding allows you to add your organization's logo and customize the email that users receive to access the Zscaler Admin Console.
The custom logo appears on the login, logout, and password reset pages.
The email that Zscaler sends is rebranded and sent from the custom email address.
Only admins with Full permissions can customize the logo and email address.
Go to Administration > Account Management > Branding.
This logo appears on the login and logout pages, and in emails.

branding-limits.statement: On the Branding page the image size should not exceed 70 KB, and the maximum length of a customized email subject line is limited to 70 characters.

quotes: The image size should not exceed 70 KB.
The maximum length of the subject line is limited to 70 characters.

branding-email-subjects.statement: Under Customize Email Subject the subject line can be changed for One-Time Code for Email Change, One-Time Code for Password Reset, One-Time Code for Account Reset, Email OTP for Authentication, New User Setup Link, One-Time Code for MFA Enrollment, New Service Enabled for Tenant, New Zscaler Service Account Created, End User Migration, SAML Cert Expiry Notification and SAML Cert Expired Notification.

quotes: Under Customize Email Subject, change the email subject line for the following, if required:
One-Time Code for Email Change
One-Time Code for Password Reset
One-Time Code for Account Reset
Email OTP for Authentication
New User Setup Link
One-Time Code for MFA Enrollment
New Service Enabled for Tenant
New Zscaler Service Account Created
End User Migration
SAML Cert Expiry Notification
SAML Cert Expired Notification

russia.statement: Zscaler provides cybersecurity services in compliance with applicable laws and does not provide services to Russian-owned entities, and requires customers to complete an End User Statement to receive Zscaler services in Russia; the form must be signed by an authorized signatory representing the company or organization, and after Zscaler receives and approves it Zscaler provides instructions on how to continue to use the services in Russia. The form can be downloaded, signed and returned by email to exportcompliance@zscaler.com, and questions about technical deployment go to z-ask-russia@zscaler.com.

quotes: Zscaler provides cybersecurity services in compliance with applicable laws and does not provide services to Russian-owned entities.
Zscaler requires customers to complete an End User Statement to receive Zscaler services in Russia.
The form must be signed by an authorized signatory representing your company or organization.
After Zscaler receives and approves your signed form, we will provide instructions on how to continue to use our services in Russia.
You can also download, sign, and return the form via email to exportcompliance@zscaler.com.
If you have any questions regarding technical deployment, send an email to z-ask-russia@zscaler.com.

logo-size.summary: The organization profile page and the onboarding logo page give a logo size of 10 KB or smaller; the Branding page, which the onboarding page says is where the logo is edited later, says the image should not exceed 70 KB.

quotes: Size of 10 KB or less
If you need to edit the logo later, you can go to Administration > Account Management > Branding.

positions.says: The onboarding logo is 10 KB or less, and is edited later at Administration > Account Management > Branding.

quotes: Company Logo: Click Upload to upload a logo. The service supports JPG, GIF, and PNG image files of 10 KB size or smaller.

positions.says: The organization profile's Company Logo supports JPG, GIF and PNG image files of 10 KB or smaller.

quotes: The image size should not exceed 70 KB.

positions.says: The Branding image size should not exceed 70 KB.

logo-size.impact: A logo between 10 KB and 70 KB is within the Branding limit and over the onboarding and organization-profile limits; the pages do not say whether the logos are one image or which limit governs.

logo-identity.title: Whether the organization-profile, Branding and onboarding logos are one image
logo-identity.detail: Three size statements exist (10 KB, 70 KB, 10 KB); no page says whether the three logos are one image. The 300 x 220 pixel bound appears only on the onboarding page (unified.onboarding).

subscriptions-scope.title: Subscription pages for other products
subscriptions-scope.detail: The Subscriptions page covers Internet & SaaS only (Administration > Subscription > Internet & SaaS); other products' subscription pages are not in this subject's sources.

branding-formats.title: Which image formats Branding accepts
branding-formats.detail: The Branding page names no accepted image formats, saying only any required format.

russia-restrictions.title: Technical restrictions on Zscaler service in Russia
russia-restrictions.detail: The Managing Zscaler Use in Russia page covers only the compliance form and gives no technical restrictions.
